question: What salutation is directed to the boon-giving, Mahiṣa-slaying goddess on behalf of devotees?
premises: The goddess is addressed as boon-giving.
The goddess is addressed as the slayer of Mahiṣa.
Salutation is offered to her for the sake of devotees.
inference: Devotees offer reverent salutation to the boon-granting, Mahiṣa-slaying goddess.
plain_english: O boon-giving goddess, slayer of Mahiṣa, may this salutation be to you for the sake of the devotees.
